description: This file defines a UI component for uploading and previewing documents in a web application. It includes multiple file upload cards, a linkedIn connect toggle, and a list of uploaded files with animated transitions. The component maintains local UI state and does not perform backend API calls.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats byte size into human-readable string with units B, KB, MB, GB.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Extracts and formats the file extension from a filename for display.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the UI title for a specific upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color accent associated with a particular upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the string of accepted file types for upload.
